units.source_text: 然而，那个人其实内心里并不满足这种商品样品的关系。

en.t: However, in his heart, that man was not really satisfied with this kind of relationship, like a sample of merchandise.

units.source_text: 譬如，那个人还躺在床上，大腿间夹着毛巾，浑身一丝不挂。

en.t: For example, that person was still lying on the bed, with a towel tucked between her thighs, completely naked.

units.source_text: 这头已经怀着自己将被轰走的心情，开始扣裤子上的扣子，那过氧化氢腾出气味的时刻……

en.t: Meanwhile, already feeling that he was about to be driven away, he began fastening the buttons of his trousers, at the moment when the hydrogen peroxide gave off its smell...
